sloka: राक्षसांस्त्रासयित्वा तु कार्तवीर्यो ऽर्जुनस्तदा ।रावणं गृह्य नगरं प्रविवेश सुहृद्वृतः ।। ७.३२.७२ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasāṁstrāsayitvā tu kārtavīryo 'rjunastadā ।rāvaṇaṁ gṛhya nagaraṁ praviveśa suhṛdvṛtaḥ ।। 7.32.72 ॥

translations.english: Then, after frightening the Rakshasas, Kartavirya Arjuna seized Ravana and entered the city, surrounded by his friends.
